description:
Majikaja, or sometimes just "Kaja," is a Narehate living in The Village of Iruburu. They can understand and communicate using human speech, though they sometimes forget words and sometimes refer to themself in the third person.
Despite being a Narehate, Majikaja`s outside body is artificial, built by a Narehate puppet maker named Jezun, and is made out of many different things gained from trading and bartering. They have a stitched-up sack in the center of their container, made of what looks like various cuttings of fabric. Majikaja`s real body is gaseous in form and contained within this sack.
Source: Made in Abyss Wiki
name: Majikaja
